Job description:
Graduate Opportunities at KiwiRail
Kickstart your career with KiwiRail and help shape the future of transport
across Aotearoa. Our Graduate Programme offers hands on experience, real
projects, and the chance to learn from experienced professionals in a
supportive, safety focused environment.

He kōrero mō mātou | About us:
At KiwiRail, we connect people, freight, and communities across Aotearoa. For
over 150 years, our rail network has played a vital role in supporting New
Zealand's economy and everyday life.
We are committed to building a more sustainable transport system for the
future. Our people work together to deliver safe, reliable services that make a
positive difference for our customers and communities. Safety, teamwork, and
care for one another are at the heart of everything we do.
He whakamārama mō te tūranga mahi | About the role:
You'll rotate through different areas of the business, gaining practical
experience and applying your academic learning in real world settings. The
programme includes structured learning, mentoring, and exposure to a 24/7
operational environment (as per business requirement), with some flexibility
required.
Ngā pūkenga e rapu nei mātou | What you will bring:
We're looking for motivated graduates who are keen to learn and contribute.
Recently completed or near completed bachelor's degree
Strong communication and teamwork skills
Analytical and problem-solving ability
Willingness to learn, adapt, and grow
Commitment to safety and wellbeing

JD example

23


Nōu te rourou | What's in it for you:
Structured graduate programme with rotations
Ongoing training, mentoring, and development
Exposure to diverse projects and teams
Opportunities for a long-term career at KiwiRail
The chance to contribute to a sustainable, essential industry
Kua rite, kia rite | Ready to make a difference?
If you're motivated to help shape the future of rail in Aotearoa, we'd love to
hear from you.
Apply online via the KiwiRail Careers site and include:
Your CV
A brief cover letter outlining your motivation and relevant skills
Your academic transcript (an unofficial copy is acceptable)
Applications close: 1 May 2026
All successful candidates will be required to complete and pass a
preemployment medical and drug screening. Due to the nature of this role,
applicants must hold New Zealand citizenship or permanent residency.
